# dev

> Shared Asgard task libraries for Ruby projects. The repo holds no application code: just `.loki` task files for Asgard (a Thor-based task runner) and a strict RuboCop overlay.

- Projects don't copy these tasks. They import them with `import_up "dev/<file>.loki"`, which searches upward from the project directory, so `dev/` can sit beside the project or beside any of its parent directories.
- `import_up "dev/.loki"` imports every top-level task file at once. It does not load the two subdirectories: a Rails repo adds `import_up "dev/rails/*.loki"`, and a client project adds `import_up "dev/client/*.loki"`.
- Every `.loki` file reopens `class Tasks`, so imported tasks merge into one command set and a repo may override any of them locally.
- `quality` discovers and runs every task whose name ends in `_check`; check tasks return `:pass`, `:fail`, `:warn` or `:skip`, and only `:fail` blocks.
- Requires asgard 0.6.0 or later (Ruby 4.0 or later). flay and reek must be installed in asgard's own Ruby.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/MadBomber/dev/blob/main/README.md): setup, requirements, contents, scheduled tasks, conventions
- [Asgard documentation](https://madbomber.github.io/asgard): the `.loki` DSL and asgard's built-in commands

## Task files

- [.loki](https://github.com/MadBomber/dev/blob/main/.loki): imports every top-level `*.loki` file (not `rails/` or `client/`)
- [gem_tasks.loki](https://github.com/MadBomber/dev/blob/main/gem_tasks.loki): gem lifecycle: `console`, `build`, `install`, `release`; imports quality.loki itself, since `build` runs the `quality` gate
- [quality.loki](https://github.com/MadBomber/dev/blob/main/quality.loki): the `quality` gate and its checks: `test_check`, `rubocop_check`, `flog_check`, `flay_check`, `reek_check`, `typos_check`, `erb_lint_check`, `fasterer_check`, `scrap_check`, `bundler_audit_check`, `archspec_check`; plus `rubocop_fix`, `typos_fix`, `reek_baseline`, `test_verbose`. `test_check` runs minitest, RSpec, or parallel RSpec depending on the repo; on a terminal with `tty-spinner` installed `quality` shows a live board; new gates report through `run_gate`, `report_gate` and `skip_gate` instead of `puts`
- [rails/quality_rails.loki](https://github.com/MadBomber/dev/blob/main/rails/quality_rails.loki): Rails-only checks, imported when `RAILS_ROOT` is set: `brakeman_check`, `rails_best_practices_check`, `ard_check` (ActiveRecordDoctor, advisory)
- [git.loki](https://github.com/MadBomber/dev/blob/main/git.loki): per-repo git basics: `push`, `pull` (fast-forward only), `fetch`
- [doc_tasks.loki](https://github.com/MadBomber/dev/blob/main/doc_tasks.loki): docs site tasks for a repo with `mkdocs.yml` or `bridgetown.config.yml`: `doc install`, `doc build`, `doc serve`, `doc open`
- [client/status_report.loki](https://github.com/MadBomber/dev/blob/main/client/status_report.loki): end-of-week client status reporting: `daily_summary` runs every `*_collect` task, `weekly_report` summarizes the week, `shell_hourly` summarizes the last hour of shell commands
- [client/ticket.loki](https://github.com/MadBomber/dev/blob/main/client/ticket.loki): Jira tickets under `asgard ticket` through jira-cli and the REST API: `show`, `mine`, `search`, `ffind`, `transitions`, `move`, `comment`, `comments`, `history`, `ready`, `children`, `remaining`, `link`, `attach`, `detach`, `create`, `pr`, `browser`, `branch` (start a branch named for the ticket), `sync` (a local mirror of changed tickets); configured by `JIRA_*` environment variables
- [iterm_tasks.loki](https://github.com/MadBomber/dev/blob/main/iterm_tasks.loki): terminal fixes: `half_duplex_screen_fix`, `clear_scroll_back_buffer`
- [branch_report.loki](https://github.com/MadBomber/dev/blob/main/branch_report.loki): `branch_report [DAYS]`, a read-only Markdown report with one row per branch, sorted into Active, Stale and Merged; uses `gh` to recognize squash-merged PRs
- [rails/db.loki](https://github.com/MadBomber/dev/blob/main/rails/db.loki): local PostgreSQL development database under `asgard db`: `status`, `tables`, `psql`, `backup`, `backups`, `dumps`, `restore` (destructive; backs up first, refuses a non-local target), `diff` of two dumps' schemas, `start`, `stop`
- [rails/db_doc.loki](https://github.com/MadBomber/dev/blob/main/rails/db_doc.loki): tbls schema docs into `notes/dbdoc`: `db_doc`, `db_doc_diff`, `db_doc_mermaid`, `db_doc_open`, `db_doc_clean`
- [rails/dev.loki](https://github.com/MadBomber/dev/blob/main/rails/dev.loki): background dev stack for a Rails app: `asgard dev up`, `down`, `status` (`bin/dev` plus Mailpit when installed)
- [runbook.loki](https://github.com/MadBomber/dev/blob/main/runbook.loki): `asgard runbook list` and `asgard runbook show NAME` over the Markdown files in `docs/runbooks`
- [aws.loki](https://github.com/MadBomber/dev/blob/main/aws.loki): AWS SSO under `asgard aws`: `login`, `logout`, `whoami`, `profiles`, `portal`; a project reopens `AwsCommands` to add its own AWS tasks
- [fake_aws.loki](https://github.com/MadBomber/dev/blob/main/fake_aws.loki): AWS's local API emulator in Docker, as `fake_aws` subcommands: `build`, `start`, `stop`, `restart`, `status`, `logs`, `version`, `exports`, `smoke`, `remove`

## Optional

- [rubocop-strict.yml](https://github.com/MadBomber/dev/blob/main/rubocop-strict.yml): overlay that keeps a few cops enabled with no exclusions; list it after `.rubocop_todo.yml` in `inherit_from`
